purpose: Record an external host's accepted create-thread execution request without confusing request acceptance with later session readback.

rules.accepted_request: host_accepted_model and host_accepted_reasoning_effort mirror the execution profile accepted at create time and are not session readback proof.
rules.no_readback: When the create receipt omits model/reasoning, host_model_readback and host_reasoning_readback remain null and readback_status is NOT_RETURNED.
rules.worker_acceptance: The attestation has acceptance false; a caller may continue only when the typed external-host contract permits accepted-request binding and independent source, session, progress, handoff, and closure readbacks still pass.
